owner.name: Mark Dielessen
owner.channel: Claude Code session (chat, Dutch), 6 November 2026; relayed word for word by the release coordinator

statements.text: we hoeven niet zo lang proef te draaien. We brengen fixes wel uit waar nodig . Je kan rc5 nu als 1.0 beschouwen en uitgeven als 1.0 release. Daarna mag je 1.1 uitbrengen met alle nieuwe mogelijkheden.

decision: The owner declares the running release candidate v1.0.0-e32v2-rc.5 (with Home Assistant integration 1.0.0rc7) to be 1.0.0: the same source is published as v1.0.0-e32v2 and ha-v1.0.0 without waiting for the 14-day readiness window, the attended switch-over tests T1-T12 or an install by someone other than the author. Fixes follow in later releases where needed; the next release is 1.1.0 with the new features. The times are to the minute (CET = UTC+1). The reasons below are written by the release tooling's author, not the owner's words.

declared_criteria.stability: Fourteen days without an unexpected restart on rc.5 are not waited for: the owner releases now. The readiness report keeps what the saved evidence measured for its window.
declared_criteria.active_control: Fourteen days of active control on rc.5 are not waited for. The E32 has run the boiler since the owner's switch-over (1 Nov 2026, 20:05Z), but the saved evidence has no history of boiler_output_enabled, so it is not measured here.
declared_criteria.trv_control: Not measured: the saved evidence has no entity list that shows whether the installation has valve-control switches; the owner releases without this measurement.
declared_criteria.failure_tests: The attended switch-over tests T1-T12 were not run; the owner releases without them and brings out fixes where needed.
declared_criteria.install_guide: Nobody other than the author has followed the install guide to the end yet; the owner releases without that test.
declared_criteria.release_window: The window on rc.5 is shorter than 14 days: the owner considers rc.5 to be 1.0 now. The report keeps the measured result (only rc.5 installed in the window).

declared_receipt_checks.backup_verified: declared by the owner: the install was made without the acceptance capture: no settings backup was taken before it, and the history cannot show one
declared_receipt_checks.boot_confirmed: declared by the owner: the history has no boot_pending flag of the E32; supporting, not proof: the uptime sensor rose without a restart for 3.07 h after the install and the update entity kept reporting the release
declared_receipt_checks.control_state_safe_after_restart: declared by the owner: the history export has no control-state entity of the E32
declared_receipt_checks.fresh_preflight_passed: declared by the owner: no saved CI answer for the exact tag was given (--ci-json)
declared_receipt_checks.independent_postcheck_passed: declared by the owner: no independent post-check was run after the install
declared_receipt_checks.settings_programs_bindings_preserved: declared by the owner: the history has no settings export from before and after the install

limits: Declared is not measured: every readiness criterion and receipt check named here was not shown by evidence; the owner decided that rc.5 is 1.0.0 without it.

rc.5 was installed by the owner through the Home Assistant update entity on 5 Nov 2026 (install 05:53:51Z-05:55:12Z, after Home Assistant offered it from 05:32:00Z; integration 1.0.0rc6 installed by HACS at 05:51:28Z) without the acceptance capture: the receipt is built from the saved Home Assistant history.
This declaration is for v1.0.0-e32v2 only. A later stable release needs its own declaration or the normal rule (an accepted capture receipt and a 14-day PASS readiness report).
